enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Sneeze. Cough.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and gathering work items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on shoes. Take out ID badge and stethoscope. Put in bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient charts. Visit patients. Take vitals. Administer medication. Talk to doctors. Attend meeting. Write reports. Eat lunch. Wash hands. Visit more patients. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update charts. Talk to nurses. Prepare for shift end. Remove scrubs. Leave hospital.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light and water heater. Remove work clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on clean clothes. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Put food on plate. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using computer for personal browsing and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open browser. Browse websites. Check email. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Walk to bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Brushing teeth and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Remove clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Breathe deeply.
